summary: Standard Lithium Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer filing on Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a home-country current report), furnished a press release announcing the filing on SEDAR+ of the Preliminary Economic Assessment technical report for the Franklin lithium-brine project in northeast Texas, developed with partner Equinor. The PEA models up to 70,000 t/y lithium carbonate over a 20-year life, a pre-tax NPV(8) of $5.9B, 25.7% IRR, $4,226/t cash operating cost and initial output in the early 2030s. No securities transaction, no deal terms; watch feasibility milestones and permitting.
